summary: Kimberly-Clark filed an 8-K announcing early tender results for exchange offers swapping any and all outstanding Kenvue notes for up to $7.0B of new Kimberly-Clark notes plus cash, alongside consent solicitations to strip Kenvue indenture covenants. Early tenders as of the October 9, 2026 Early Participation Date secured requisite consents for all series; Kenvue executed a supplemental indenture, operative only on settlement. Settlement is expected after the Expiration Date (October 27, 2026, extendable) and on or about closing of Kimberly-Clark's pending Kenvue acquisition, not before November 2, 2026. Watch acquisition closing and noteholder participation.
